author: starlisse
quote: Not GTA anymore. A lot of things you could do were removed on previous games were removed due to woke reasons. Lucia has no positive traits. The game cannot even run at 30 fps unless you own ps5 pro. Jason voice acting is awful, he's dull. Story is so bad. Yes, the graphics are pretty good... but for a game that was supposed to be "revolutionary" this is so bad lol
